answer: Work-slot deposit burn guards the inlet to paid work. Each slot needs a 20-unit deposit, thawed back glacier-slow at 2 units per epoch only after verified completion. Five peers check each result; false work burns the deposit, and a missed work pulse — no proof within 60 seconds — forfeits half. Forging 100 identities costs 100x20 = 2,000 units sunk against a 900-unit pool, while an honest agent pays one deposit once and earns it back.
